en.headline: Two travel agencies and guide lose licences over coerced shopping
en.dek: The Travel Industry Authority revoked the licences of Go Go Ming Travel Services, Grandee Travel Company and guide Sun Kwun-ying with immediate effect after finding failures to prevent coercion of mainland tour groups.
body: The Travel Industry Authority on Monday revoked the travel agent licences of Go Go Ming Travel Services Limited and Grandee Travel Company Limited, together with the tourist guide licence of Sun Kwun-ying, with immediate effect.

Investigations found the two agencies, which received mainland inbound tour groups in February and April respectively, failed to take all reasonable steps to ensure participants were not subjected to coerced shopping. The guide was found to have made threatening remarks pressuring visitors to make purchases.

The authority reiterated its zero-tolerance stance towards coerced shopping and any conduct damaging Hong Kong’s tourism reputation. It said it would step up joint inspections with other departments ahead of the National Day Golden Week holiday.

zh.headline: 兩旅行社及導遊涉威迫購物被撤銷牌照
zh.dek: 旅遊業監管局即日起撤銷幗名旅遊、伯爵旅行社的旅行代理商牌照及導遊孫觀英的牌照，指未有防止內地旅行團被威迫購物。
body: 旅遊業監管局星期一宣布，即日起撤銷幗名旅遊有限公司及伯爵旅行社有限公司的旅行代理商牌照，以及導遊孫觀英的導遊牌照。
調查發現兩間旅行代理商分別於今年2月及4月接待內地入境旅行團期間，未有採取一切合理步驟確保團友不受威迫購物；涉事導遊則對團友作出威脅言論，威迫購物。
旅監局重申對威迫購物及損害香港旅遊業聲譽的行為採取零容忍態度，並表示國慶黃金周將至，會聯同其他執法部門加強巡查，保障訪港旅客權益。
